sections.title: Letter sound ge
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (гэ) /ɡɛ/. Its main sound is the sound /ɡ/, that is a hard g, as in the word (город) /ˈɡorət/, which means city, town. This letter can make four different sounds.

sections.title: How to say ge
paragraphs: Raise the back of your tongue to touch the soft roof of your mouth. Release the air suddenly with your voice on. For the softer sound, raise the middle of your tongue at the same time. For the unvoiced sound, turn off your voice. For the last sound, press your upper teeth against your lower lip and breathe out. Touch your throat to feel it shake.

sections.title: Spelling rules for ge
paragraphs: Before hard vowels and voiced consonants, it makes the sound /ɡ/, that is a hard g, as in (глаз) /ɡlas/. Before soft vowels, it makes the sound /ɡʲ/, that is a soft g, as in (где) /ɡʲdʲe/. At the end of a word, it sounds like the sound /k/, as in (друг) /druk/. In specific pronoun endings, it sounds like the sound /v/, as in (его) /jɪˈvo/.

sections.title: Comparing ge
paragraphs: Do not add a small puff of air when you say the hard sound. English g in goose is voiced, but keep the stop firm and clean. Do not turn the sound into h in house. When the letter softens, keep the back of the tongue raised while you press the middle upward. Never make a w sound in endings, but bite your lip lightly like the v in vine.
